patch_description: Replace the single sharp final polish with a small deterministic portfolio of continuation paths. Near the observed 0.24 plateau, different active contact graphs can be reached by either retaining the existing sharp path, spending time in a moderate-contact stage before sharpening, or making a very small symmetry-breaking tangent perturbation before the sharp pass. Each branch is evaluated solely by the exact min/max squared-distance ratio, so additional surrogate paths cannot replace a superior incumbent unless they improve the true objective.
